thread:
oncall-robin: Pager fired — spike of 5xxs on /v1/generate for the hosted API. Canary group c2 shows ~18% 5xx over last 3m. Alert: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abc123/canary-rollouts
incidents-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1127 (canary-failure). Paging primary oncall.
incidents-bot: Runbook: https://confluence.internal/incidents/rollbacks - follow rollback + verification section.
morgan: I'm looking at the canary dashboard, error is "KV cache OOM" in the runtime logs, stacktrace pointing at model-serving process. Is kill-switch for feature flag available?
sasha: @morgan yes kill switch on feature-flag service is ready. We can flip rollout -> stable. Suggest kill switch first, then rollback if traffic doesn't normalize.
morgan: Agreed. Lia, can you prepare traffic shift back to stable and pause further canary traffic?
eng-platform-lia: Pausing rollout now. Command I ran: ```curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP' https://ff.internal/api/v1/flags/rollouts/c2/pause -d '{"action":"pause"}'```
eng-sre-kate: Deploy logs showing OOM errors during KV load. Locking the model cache until we confirm memory tuning fix.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026-03-15T02:05 triggered -> PAUSE acknowledged. No new canary instances will be started.
morgan: Flipped the feature flag kill-switch for c2: ```PATCH /api/flags/canary-c2 {"enabled": false}``` Traffic should shift to stable within ~30s.
qa-jordan: Running quick smoke now against stable: ```for i in {1..10}; do curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate; done```
qa-jordan: Results: 200 x9, 504 x1 (first request probably warming). That's much better than 18% 5xx.
sasha: Good. Kate, can you start manual rollback of the canary release image just to be safe? Provide commands so we have step-by-step record.
eng-sre-kate: Initiating manual rollback to image redwood/serve:2026-03-07-stable. Steps: ```kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/serve-canary --to-image=redwood/serve:2026-03-07-stable && kubectl rollout status deployment/serve-canary -n prod``` I'm starting now.
eng-sre-kate: Rollout undo started — watching pods recreate. Logs: "pod serve-canary-2 rebooted, image pulled, health checks passing"
morgan: Confirming health checks on canary group are green from load-balancer side.
eng-platform-lia: Shift traffic back to 100% stable completed. Verified by traffic matrix: stable=100%, canary=0% for tenant-hosted endpoints.
incidents-bot: Automated alert suppression enabled for this incident window.
sasha: Quick customer impact note: Support reported ~120 requests failed for customers on hosted tier between 02:03-02:06 UTC. Initial estimate: ~1.2% of requests for that minute window. @support-patrick will follow up on msg/CSAT.
support-patrick: On it. Drafting a short status message for affected customers now. Will post proposed language in #support-updates.
qa-jordan: Post-rollback verification: ran evaluation prompt set against stable image and saw latencies normal and no 5xx. Sample: "completion latency ~220ms, 200 responses".
morgan: Can we capture exact error log snippet for postmortem? Kate, paste the minimal lines.
eng-sre-kate: Error snippet: ```2026-03-15T02:04:12Z serve[pid=412]: ERROR runtime::kv_cache: allocation failed: cannot grow cache beyond 2GB -> OOM while allocating 196608 bytes```
sasha: Noted. Probable regression from cache size change in 2026-03-15 canary image. We'll add a safety limit to deployment config.
morgan: Actions captured: 1) Kill-switch flipped (done). 2) Rollback to stable (done). 3) Traffic reverted (done). 4) Collect logs + create postmortem (sasha + kate). 5) Support notification (patrick). 6) Follow-up: add automated guard in CI to detect KV cache config spikes (eng+ml).
eng-sre-kate: Leaving a ticket: BUG-3112 created to track cache config revert and CI guard: https://jira.internal/browse/BUG-3112
incidents-bot: Incident INC-2026-1127 status -> mitigated.
morgan: I'll hand off to night oncall for monitoring. @qa-jordan, @eng-platform-lia — any open items to track?
qa-jordan: Please monitor for any regressions overnight; I'll run the extended smoke every hour for next 6 hours.
eng-platform-lia: I will keep traffic rules pinned to stable until we validate a new canary build.
sasha: Handoff to night oncall @oncall-robin -> @morgan -> @qa-jordan: summary + checklist attached to incident doc. Remaining: confirm no residual errors, verify postmortem draft, and block canary re-deploys until fix lands.
oncall-robin: Acknowledged, taking over monitoring. Will escalate if any reoccur within the next 4h. :white_check_mark:
morgan: Thanks team. Closing the active coordination in this thread; will update postmortem link here once ready.
incidents-bot: Incident INC-2026-1127 closed in channel.
